description: Number and Length Of Bulk Service Connections (2023) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset records the number and total length of bulk water service connections categorized by pipe diameter and type of service activity. Bulk service connections refer to high-capacity water pipelines typically used for commercial, industrial, or municipal supply. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water, connection, pipe, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, transport network and mobility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
